home.title: Your AI copilot for landing the next job
home.subtitle: Build a standout resume, get matched to real openings across the Gulf, Lebanon, and the wider Middle East & Africa region, apply in one click, and let an AI assistant guide you the whole way — in Arabic or English.
home.trustedBy: Trusted by job seekers across Riyadh, Jeddah, Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Beirut, Cairo, Amman & beyond

features.title: Everything you need to get hired, faster

resume.title: Build & enhance your resume
resume.desc: Upload an existing resume or build one from scratch. Our AI rewrites bullet points, tailors it to each job, and checks it against ATS keyword filters.

search.title: Smart job search
search.desc: We scan thousands of real openings from verified company career pages and job boards across the Gulf, the Levant, Egypt, and globally, matched to your profile every day.

apply.title: One-click apply
apply.desc: Apply instantly where supported, or get a pre-filled application ready in one extra click on the source site — never a blind auto-submit bot.

tracker.title: Application tracker
tracker.desc: See every application's status in one board: saved, applied, interview, offer.

chatbot.title: AI job-search assistant
chatbot.desc: Ask anything — resume feedback, interview prep, salary questions — and get answers grounded in your own profile, any time.

bilingual.title: Arabic & English, built in
bilingual.desc: A fully right-to-left Arabic experience alongside English, not a bolt-on translation.
